brief:
# Esika, God of the Tree

> **Seed:** My mom picked Esika as her first 'I might wanna try Magic with this' commander, and it is the first 5-color that actually speaks to me too. My deck, high power, real cards.

Fill the front matter first: `mode`, `tier`, `source`, `assembly` (the three forks in `PROCESS.md`).
Then `python3 _tools/deck.py check <this folder>` tells you the next step.

## Thesis

**DRAFT by Claude, rewritten 2026-11-15 after Dug's correction. Not ratified.**
(11-14 draft made poison the end state; Dug: the point is to win "11 ways to Sunday", not copy Harry's poison. Option 1 chosen.)

*Thesis:* Esika turns a hand-picked cast of legends into five-colour mana; The Prismatic Bridge, MV1 tutors and
Raph & Mikey put the heavy hitters onto the battlefield; the deck wins many ways.

*End state:* any one finisher on the battlefield plus the wave-1 evasion or protection ends the game, or an
alternate win resolves. Target about 8 independent kill lines, each a creature or planeswalker where possible so the
Bridge and the tutors can find it. Poison (Fynn + one granter) is one line among them. No commander damage.
Price per line goes in the wave-2 file; the cheapest kill on the list so far is Reverse the Polarity with any big board.

*Finisher rule:* a finisher ends the game by itself or within one more turn. Value bodies (Etali, Kozilek) are not finishers.

*Tier flag:* tier 3 declared. Kiki-Jiki + Zealous Conscripts is the only true combo candidate so far.

*Pool rule (Dug):* known favourites, recent additions and everything in bulk. Known-but-unowned favourites
(Yidris, Flubs, Zuko Firebending Master, Storm Force of Nature, Esika) are exempt. Proxy cap: LIFTED by Dug 2026-11-14.

*Curve rule (Dug):* MV1 = Sensei's Divining Top + tutors only; load up the 2-drops.

## Commander

Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge. Why: Dug's first five-colour commander that speaks to him;
his own "all the heavy hitters of my choice" deck, after Justice's Kenrith list.

*Floor:* front face is a 3-mana 1/4 that taps for any colour, so a bad draw still fixes five colours.
Killed on sight: recast at 5, or switch to the Bridge at 5 (7 after one death). The 99 must work with neither face out.

*Support density:* 106 owned legendary creatures in WUBRG (collq, 2026-11-14), about 85 at mana value 4 or less;
about 8 owned bodies worth a Bridge flip. Trace: Zuko, Firebending Master under Esika gains vigilance and
"{T}: Add one mana of any color" (he is another legendary creature). Under the Bridge he is a legal reveal (creature card).

## Skeleton

**DRAFT by Claude, 2026-11-14. Not ratified by Dug.** Buckets overlap: a low card that grants unblockable and protects counts in both.

| Slot | BUILD-SPEC standard | This deck's target | Why it differs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lands | ~37 | 36 | Esika and every legend tap for any colour |
| Ramp / fixing | 10-11 | 7 rocks/spells + Esika + legend dorks | The cast is the ramp; rocks only at MV2-3 |
| Draw | 8-9 | 8 (Ohran Frostfang, Flubs, Sensei's Divining Top count) | Same as spec: the triad ran out of cards |
| Interaction (4 instant, 2 ench, 1 art, 1 non-targeted) | 8-10 | 8 | Same as spec |
| Wipes | 0-2 | 1 (Ori, one-sided) | Creature wipes kill our own plan |
| Protection (not in spec) | - | 5 | Fynn and the granter are single points of failure |
| Unblockable / evasion grants | - | 5 | Dug: connect instants that still do something late |
| Recursion | - | 6 | Dug: cascade into recursion to bring legends back |
| The plan (creatures) | ~35 | about 30, 14 of them MV6+ | Bridge quality: big bodies, few cheap creatures |

## Staircase (draft, by mana value)

Rule (Dug): thin low end, staggered, so Yidris cascade lands on known jobs. Cheap slots are mostly noncreature,
because every cheap creature is a weak Bridge flip. Every low card must still do something late (Dug: no wasted spell).

| MV | Count | Creatures | Noncreature jobs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4-5 | 0 | Sensei's Divining Top + tutors only (Dug 11-15): every MV2 cascade finds Top or a tutor |
| 2 | 18 | 2 (Fynn, Zuko Firebending Master) | loaded up (Dug 11-15): 4 protection, 4 unblockable, 3 recursion, 5 ramp |
| 3 | 11 | 3 (Flubs + 2) | 2 protection, 1 unblockable, 2 recursion, 3 ramp |
| 4 | 12 | about 6 (Yidris, Saryth, Storm Force of Nature ...) | interaction, draw |
| 5 | 8 | about 5 (Ohran Frostfang, Cosmic Spider-Man ...) | interaction |
| 6+ | 14 | 14 (Ozai Phoenix King, Iroh Grand Lotus, Etali, Drakuseth, Ori, Ghalta, Zaffai ...) | - |

Cascade odds below were computed for the 11-14 counts (MV1=1, MV2=14, MV3=14); recompute after wave picks.
Cascade odds (random among nonland cards below the cast spell's MV):
- Off a 2-drop: Sensei's Divining Top, 100%.
- Off a 3-drop (15 eligible): recursion 13%, unblockable 20%, protection 20%, ramp 27%, creature 13%, Top 7%.
- Off a 4-drop (29 eligible): recursion 21%, unblockable 17%, protection 17%, ramp 24%, creature 17%, Top 3%.
Bridge: about 30 creatures, about 19 at MV5+, so about 63% of flips are MV5+ before Top.

Box check (collq, MV<=3, noncreature): recursion 1 (Generous Revival), unblockable 1 (Hire a Crew),
protection 6 (Heroic Intervention, Snakeskin Veil, Duty Beyond Death, Vigorbloom Charm x2, Nowhere to Run).
Sensei's Divining Top: not owned.


### Gate, 2026-11-15 (cardq check on esika-god-of-the-tree_decklist.txt)

Compiled from the wave picker board: 63 nonland + 36 lands + Esika. No colour or legality errors.
Curve 1:4 2:17 3:18 4:9 5:5 6:7 7:2 8:1 9:1. Pips G30 R23 U19 B17 W17; sources G25 U18 W17 R17 B16.

| Quota | Spec | Count | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lands | 36-38 | 36 | ok |
| Ramp | 10-11 | 10 (incl. Captain America, Electro by #q tag) | ok |
| Draw | 8-9 | 6 + 2 filter (Thrill, Abandon Attachments) | **LOW, not bent.** Walkers draw repeatedly (Bolas +1) but the triad ran out of cards; fix proposed to Dug |
| Removal | 8-10 | 10 | ok |
| Interaction sub-floors: enchantment 0, artifact 0, non-targeted 0 | 2 / 1 / 1 | heuristic miss | **Bend:** Beast Within, Generous Gift, Chaos Warp and Anguished Unmaking hit any permanent (enchantments and artifacts). Non-targeted: Nicol Bolas +1 (each opponent exiles). Claude's reading, not Dug's |

Lands are Claude's draft (14 always-tapped: Path, Crossroads, 4 tri-lands, Temple of Enlightenment, 7 triomes). Pull list: work/waves/have-2026-11-15.txt.
Goldfish, 5 draw-7 hands (seeds 1001-1005): keep 1, 4; mulligan 2 (one land); 3 and 5 have no GG for Esika on turn 3.


### Cascade map, 2026-11-15 (after the Fblthp/Harmonize swaps)

Yidris gives cascade to spells cast from hand after he deals combat damage. Cascade casts the first nonland card with lower MV.
No nonland card has MV 0, so:
- **Cast a 2-drop:** always hits an MV1 card: Sensei's Divining Top, Mystical, Vampiric or Worldly Tutor (4 of 4 are hits).
  Worldly or Vampiric on a creature puts it on top, so the Bridge flips it next upkeep.
- **Cast a 3-drop:** hits one of 21 (4 MV1 + 17 MV2). 20 are live after combat; Heroic Intervention is the blank.
- **Cast a 4-drop:** hits one of 37. Blanks after combat: Heroic Intervention, Reverse the Polarity (unless Aurelia gives another combat),
  One Last Job (the {2} spree cost still has to be paid). About 34 of 37 live.
Jodah's cascade is separate: legendary spells from hand, into a cheaper legendary nonland card.


### Update, 2026-11-15 evening: MV0 suspend cards, Sol Ring, 35 lands

In: Hypergenesis, Profane Tutor, Inevitable Betrayal (no mana cost, MV 0), Sol Ring. Out: Three Visits, One Last Job,
Heroic Intervention, Rogue's Passage. cardq: 64 nonland + 35 lands; ramp 11, draw 8, removal 10, protection 9.
**Land bend (Dug, 11-15): 35 against a spec of 36-38.** Reason: Sol Ring plus 10 other ramp pieces plus Esika's legends.
Rogue's Passage was the cut land: colourless only, and its evasion is covered more cheaply (Reverse the Polarity,
You Come to a River, Key to the City, Tetsuko).

Cascade map now (replaces the one above):
- **Cast a 1-drop** after Yidris connects: hits an MV0 card for certain: Hypergenesis, Profane Tutor or Inevitable Betrayal.
- **Cast a 2-drop:** hits one of 8 (3 MV0 + 5 MV1: Top, Mystical, Vampiric, Worldly, Sol Ring). All 8 are live.
- **Cast a 3-drop:** hits one of 23 (adds the 15 two-drops). Heroic Intervention, the old blank, is gone: all live.
- Hypergenesis is symmetric: every opponent may drop their hand too, starting with you.


### Mana base for Esika on time, 2026-11-15 (Dug: "need to make sure Esika is always out on time")

Swaps: Savai Triome, Xander's Lounge, Arcane Sanctum, Temple of Enlightenment -> Wooded Foothills, Windswept Heath,
Verdant Catacombs, Misty Rainforest. Opulent Palace, Frontier Bivouac, Sandsteppe Citadel, Crossroads Village ->
Plaza of Heroes, Mana Confluence, City of Brass, Forest. All 7 new nonbasic lands are proxies.
Measured with a mana simulation (work/esika_mana_sim.py, 20,000 games each; models land drops, tapped lands, Sol Ring,
Signet, Fellwar, Nature'

profile.strategy:
Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge. Esika (front, {1}{G}{G}) gives your other legendary creatures vigilance and '{T}: Add one mana of any color'. The Bridge (back, WUBRG) puts the first creature or planeswalker from the top of your library onto the battlefield each upkeep.
Thesis (draft, not ratified): Esika turns a hand-picked cast of legends into five-colour mana; the Bridge, the MV1 tutors and Raph & Mikey put the heavy hitters onto the battlefield; the deck wins many ways (Craterhoof, Ozai, Aurelia extra combats, Elspeth's flying team, Fynn poison, Reverse the Polarity for a team-unblockable swing, Lure on a deathtouch attacker). No commander damage at this table.
Keep rule (draw-7): keep 3-5 lands with at least one green source, or 2 lands with a green source plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone or Nature's Lore. Mulligan everything else. Goal: Esika on turn 3 (about 91% with this rule, mana sim 2026-11-15).
Cascade (Yidris after he deals combat damage; Abaddon for spells with MV up to the life opponents lost this turn, from any source; spells cast from hand): a 1-drop always cascades into Hypergenesis, Profane Tutor or Inevitable Betrayal; a 2-drop hits one of those or Top / Mystical / Vampiric / Worldly / Sol Ring / Swords to Plowshares. Worldly or Vampiric on a creature puts it on top for the next Bridge flip.
Engines: Captain America untaps each creature the first time it taps on your turn (every legend taps for Esika mana twice). Tetsuko makes Fynn, Esika and other 1-power creatures unblockable. Zuko gains experience for any spell cast in any combat; Leyline of Anticipation lets instants and creatures go in opponents' combats. Ozai and Electro keep red mana between steps; Wulfgar doubles attack triggers.
Hypergenesis is symmetric: everyone may drop their hand, starting with you.
Gods (Kolvori, Inga and Esika, Valki, Ilharg) tap for mana under Esika; Inga and Esika lets every creature tap for creature mana. Ilharg puts a creature from your hand onto the battlefield attacking: the fix for a hand of big cards. The World Tree: with 10 mana (WWUUBBRRGG) sacrifice it to put every God in your library onto the battlefield. Lure + Bow of Nylea (attackers have deathtouch) kills every creature able to block; everything else gets through. Foul Renewal returns a big creature and gives -X/-X equal to its toughness (Ghalta 8). Brandon (Daretti): he never casts his artifacts, he sacrifices or discards them and returns them from the graveyard, so counters don't stop them. Shrink his graveyard: Quandrix Command (instant) or Gaea's Blessing shuffle 3 of his graveyard cards into his library, Farewell's graveyard mode exiles them all. Exile what lands (Farewell artifacts mode, Despark, Swords on creatures); remove Portal to Phyrexia the turn it lands. Keep Daretti under 10 loyalty.
